facts.fact: Decree 2024-073 (Article 11 and Article 13) makes every poor or vulnerable household enrolled in the Registre Social eligible for Tekavoul regular and shock-response cash transfers, within a national quota set by the Government.

systems.owner: Taazour (Delegation Generale a la Solidarite Nationale et a la Lutte contre l'Exclusion)
systems.tiers: regular conditional transfers; Tekavoul Choc temporary unconditional transfers

note: The decree states no digital payment channel, so no payment fact.
